extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.27[CR]- Genre tiles use the artwork of their first matching Prime movie/TV card; remove premade genre illustrations from the grid.[CR]- Load previews asynchronously through shared first-page requests, with two background workers and foreground priority when a genre is selected.[CR]- Extras displays Amazon's individual subscription services, including unsubscribed services, with provider branding and actual catalog links.[CR]- Follow Browse all subscriptions instead of flattening promoted shows into a generic subscription section.[CR]- Read the active Kodi skin font's Unicode coverage, preserve supported text and normalize or replace missing glyphs gracefully.[CR]- Draw the season chevron using native geometry so it cannot become a missing-font box; allow more space for In Progress.[CR]- Record actual font identity/coverage, replacement codepoints, preview failures and service-directory stages without account or authentication secrets.[CR]- Preserve existing glow textures, pagination, focus retention, fresh In Progress, sign-out purge and native login/playback implementations.

extension.description: Delivers updates for the standalone Prime Scene add-on. The index is now hosted by ScottyWins.
